description: FindWeedNY's own independent, lab-anchored reviews of New York cannabis products (flower, vapes, concentrates, edibles). Every review has a 1–5 rating and, for cannabis products, the COA numbers: THC %, total terpenes %, top terpenes, plus a link to the certificate of analysis. Filter by brand, product type, strain, cultivation method, or minimum rating; sort by date, rating, or terpenes. Use this for "is brand X any good", "best-tested flower", or "most terpene-rich vape" questions. Rows carry an excerpt and a `url` to the full review.
